summary: Iteration 72 - iOS WebRTC Bug Fixes, Editorial Calendar Drag-Drop, Service Layer Extraction: All 25 backend tests passed (100%). Frontend tests verified Editorial Calendar dialog with drag-drop targets, navigation controls, and legend. PreJoinPage shows media-permission-error overlay correctly. iOS-specific UI elements are conditionally rendered (verified in code review).
critical_code_review_comments: iOS WebRTC: PreJoinPage.js has translateMediaError() mapping NotAllowedError->NotAllowed, NotFoundError->NotFound, NotReadableError->NotReadable, OverconstrainedError->Overconstrained, SecurityError->Security
iOS WebRTC: PreJoinPage.js has data-testid='media-permission-error' overlay with title+message
iOS WebRTC: PreJoinPage.js has data-testid='ios-permission-hint' with 3-step iPhone settings instructions (conditional on isIOS && NotAllowed)
iOS WebRTC: PreJoinPage.js has data-testid='retry-media-btn' button (conditional on needsUserGesture after NotAllowed/NotReadable)
iOS WebRTC: PreJoinPage.js has data-testid='ios-preflight-hint' banner (conditional on isIOS && !permissionError && !streamRef.current)
iOS WebRTC: PreJoinPage.js startMedia uses plain {video:true, audio:true} on first request, falls back on OverconstrainedError/NotFoundError
iOS WebRTC: LiveMeetingPage.js has data-testid='media-error-banner' at top with retry button
iOS WebRTC: LiveMeetingPage.js RemoteVideo has data-testid='remote-tap-{peerId}' tap-to-play overlay for iOS autoplay blocking
iOS WebRTC: LiveMeetingPage.js VideoMirror calls video.play() explicitly for iOS compatibility
BACKEND: GET /api/meetings/{id}/mode-config returns {mode, config} with correct config for standard/moderated/webinar/training modes
BACKEND: services/meetings_modes.py exports MEETING_MODE_CONFIG, get_mode_config_for, is_valid_mode, list_modes
BACKEND: services/meetings_summaries.py has auto_send_summary_email function, trampoline in routes/meetings.py delegates correctly
BACKEND: services/llm_key.py has get_llm_key() resolving from api_config DB first, env second
FRONTEND: EditorialCalendar has drag-drop: draggable posts (data-testid='cal-post-{id}'), drop targets (data-testid='cal-day-{YYYY-MM-DD}')
FRONTEND: EditorialCalendar handleDrop calls PUT /api/news/posts/{id} with publish_at updated, status upgraded to 'scheduled' for drafts
seed_data_creation: Test data created during tests was cleaned up via fixture teardown
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 72 tested: (1) iOS WebRTC bug fixes - code review verified all data-testid attributes present: media-permission-error, ios-permission-hint, retry-media-btn, ios-preflight-hint in PreJoinPage.js; media-error-banner, retry-media-btn, remote-tap-{peerId} in LiveMeetingPage.js. translateMediaError maps error codes correctly. startMedia uses plain constraints first, falls back on OverconstrainedError/NotFoundError. Frontend has draggable posts and drop targets with correct data-testids. (3) Service layer extraction - meetings_modes.py, meetings_summaries.py, llm_key.py all working. GET /api/meetings/{id}/mode-config returns correct config for all 4 modes. auto_send_summary_email trampoline works without NameError. (4) Regression - participant_count (instant=1, scheduled=0), soft-cancel series, editorial-calendar endpoint, send-invitations, news/push/send all still working.
